storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for Vimeo makes it easy to save videos from Vimeo.com and embedded Vimeo players on any website.

How it works: Go to any Vimeo video page or any page with an embedded Vimeo player. The extension automatically detects the video from multiple sources -- Vimeo's player config, inline scripts, the config API, and more. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon, pick your quality, and the video downloads as a standard MP4 file.

It handles HLS adaptive streaming, progressive downloads, and password-protected videos automatically. No external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection from Vimeo player config, config API, inline scripts, JSON-LD, and DOM analysis
- Detects embedded Vimeo players on any website (courses, portfolios, event pages)
- In-page overlay download button on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Password-protected video support
- Multiple video selection when a page contains more than one video
- Real-time download progress with concurrent download queue
- Cross-tab download manager with persistent state
- Dark-themed UI with cyan accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Vimeo.com or any page with an embedded Vimeo player
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and download -- saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video?
faq.answer: Go to any Vimeo video page or a page with an embedded Vimeo player. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon in your toolbar. Select your quality and click Download.

faq.question: Does this work with embedded Vimeo videos on other websites?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects Vimeo player iframes on any website -- course platforms, portfolios, event pages, and more.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from Vimeo's stream data -- typically multiple resolutions with different bitrates. Progressive (direct MP4) and HLS streams are both supported.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Can I download password-protected videos?
faq.answer: Yes. If a video is password-protected, the popup will prompt you to enter the password before downloading.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes -- supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Make sure the Vimeo player has loaded on the page. If the page has multiple Vimeo embeds, the extension will show a selection list. Try refreshing the page if detection fails.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP -- no passwords stored.
